source: Agent-maintained. Reads fluent.config.json + built-in defaults, records resolved effective presets and clarifications so they are not re-asked. See research/config-design.md.

typography.fontFamily: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

decisions.question: Confirm the brand color and how to build the Fluent BrandVariants ramp: generate all 16 slots from #5B2E91, or use a hand-authored ramp?
decisions.answer: Use #5B2E91 as brand slot 80 and generate the full 16-slot ramp with fluent_generate_theme; no hand-authored ramp override.

decisions.question: Icon-only buttons must still meet the 24px minimum target size (WCAG 2.5.8, AA). Which default control size satisfies this?
decisions.answer: Use size='medium' (32px control height) for icon-only buttons so the hit area exceeds the 24px minimum; reserve size='small' (24px) for dense toolbars only.

decisions.question: For the Power BI report theme, derive the categorical dataColors from the brand ramp or use Fluent's default categorical set?
decisions.answer: Derive the categorical palette from the brand ramp, verified >= 3:1 contrast against the report background; keep colorBrandBackground for primary emphasis only.
